dct_creator_sm: Wright, Claire (Queen's University, University of Victoria).
dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains example data for the Mountain Image Analysis Suite (MIAS) plugin for QGIS. The plugin is available for download through GitHub. MIAS was developed on images from the Mountain Legacy Project. A written tutorial is available for download. The dataset contains the following layers:
  1. Digital surface model at 1 m resolution for the Lost Horse Creek Valley in Waterton Lakes National Park, AB, Canada provided by Parks Canada.
  2. Digital terrain model at 1 m resolution for the Lost Horse Creek Valley in Waterton Lakes National Park, AB, Canada provided by Parks Canada.
  3. High resolution oblique image from the Mountain Legacy Project collection captured on the shoulder of Mt Blakiston by Dominion Land Surveyor Morrison P. Bridgland in 1914.
  4. High resolution oblique image from the Mountain Legacy Project collection captured on the shoulder of Mt Blakiston by Mountain Legacy researchers in 2004.
  5. Corresponding landcover classification masks created in MIAS for the two oblique images with associated probability layers (.npy).
  6. Virtual photograph constructed from elevation data through MIAS replicating the view in the two oblique images.
  7. Text file with the camera parameters used to create the virtual photograph.
  8. Aligned versions of the two landcover masks after alignment with the virtual photograph and the associated alignment tie points.
  9. Viewsheds for each oblique image comprising classified and georeferenced rasters, and associated probability layers for use in mosaicking.
dct_title_s: Mountain Image Analysis Suite Tutorial Data
